key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll the codexbar CLI. Countdowns between fetches still tick every minute.

key.name: show-pace
key.summary: Show pace lines under usage meters
key.description: Whether to show whether a window is running ahead of or behind its expected pace.

key.name: primary-provider
key.summary: Provider tracked by the panel bar
key.description: codexbar provider id (for example codex, claude, opencodego) whose usage fills the panel indicator. Empty means the first provider with usage data.

key.name: show-browser-summary
key.summary: Allow optional browser-session access and display usage
key.description: Explicit consent for the separately started helper to read matching browser credentials and display sanitized usage. Settings are checked within one minute between refreshes; in-flight requests may finish after switching off.

key.name: browser-profile
key.summary: Browser profile selected for optional usage data
key.description: Single profile selection shared by the helper and popup. Required before credential access; also prevents displaying cached data from another profile.

key.name: browser-refresh-interval
key.summary: Browser helper polling interval in minutes

key.name: browser-codex-email
key.description: Reject a browser session with a different account email. Empty disables this additional match check.

key.name: browser-flaresolverr-url
key.summary: Optional trusted FlareSolverr address for Codex
key.description: Empty disables FlareSolverr. A configured server receives ChatGPT session cookies when solving confirmed Cloudflare challenges.
